answer: An agent economy can defend itself like a canyon: funnel high-value jobs through a narrow verified gateway where every agent must show a relic, a non-transferable receipt chain proving past useful work. Fresh sybil identities arrive with no relic and are turned away at the gate, while an honest agent's relic works like an oasis stamp in a passport, cheap to show and impossible to fake without doing the work. Forging one relic costs as much as earning it, so mass-producing identities buys nothing.
